tags.bug: In Death March, destroyed weapons now correctly retain their destroyed status and appearance when continuing to the next battle.
Fixed an issue in Death March where destroyed weapons were not repaired after selecting "Select another boss" or "Restart from the beginning".
Fixed a bug where the increased damage from the "Uroboros’s Eye" Handle Fable Arts was not applied correctly.
Fixed a bug where closing the game with a weapon's durability at 0 caused it to be displayed as destroyed after relaunching the game.

notes.title: Lies of P Patch Notes: Overture Launch
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2848330/Lies_of_P_Overture/
[h2]Changes[/h2][h3]Added support for the Lies of P: Overture DLC.[/h3]
[list][*][p] The DLC must be purchased separately.[/p][/*][*][p] To start Lies of P: Overture, you must first reach Chapter 9 [spoiler]and repair the Hotel Stargazer.[/spoiler][/p][/*][*][p] Once you've met these conditions, [spoiler]you will be able to enter the Forgotten Time.[/spoiler][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Added the new Boss Rematch system. [/h3][list][*][p] The Boss Rematch system features two modes where you can challenge bosses you've previously defeated:[/p][list][*][p] Battle Memories: Fight bosses that you've previously defeated.[/p][/*][*][p] Death March: Fight through a series of 3 or more bosses consecutively with limited HP and items.
[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]To unlock the Boss Rematch system, you must first complete the main story and reach one of the endings. Both modes can then be accessed through the Hotel Stargazer.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Added "Difficulty" options.[/h3][list][*][p] You can now select between 3 levels of game difficulty to further tailor the gameplay to your playstyle and preference.[/p][/*][*][p] The difficulty can be changed at any time in \[Settings → Gameplay → Difficulty].[/p][/*][*][p] With this patch, the overall difficulty from the 4th playthrough onward has been increased.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Because this patch introduces many changes affecting player controls, all button and key settings in \[Settings → Controller] and \[Settings → Keyboard & Mouse] have been reset. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.[/h3][p][/p][h3]Added "Colorblind Mode".[/h3][list][*][p] You can set "Colorblind Mode" and "Colorblind Mode Intensity" in \[Settings → Gameplay].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]New Quality of Life features have been added to the P-Organ.[/h3][list][*][p] You can now check the current state of the P-Organ using the new "P-Organ Info" function in \[Menu → Character Info].[/p][/*][*][p] The "Reset P-Organ" feature has been replaced with "P-Organ Recalibration". You can now remove/equip individual Quartz or reset the P-Organ at the Saintess of Mercy Statue or the Gold Coin Tree.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]The P-Organ's "Quick Wishstone use" ability has been changed to a default ability. This ability has been replaced by a new ability in the P-Organ: "Lowers Damage temporarily when using the Wishstone".[/h3][p][/p][h3]Changed the movement control settings for "Dash" and "Dodge".[/h3][list][*][p] "Dash" and "Dodge" actions can now be assigned to separate keys/buttons.[/p][/*][*][p] The "Dash" action will function as a toggle if separate keys/buttons are assigned for these actions. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Added an option to automatically lock on a target you attack.[/h3][list][*][p] You can adjust this setting in \[Settings → Gameplay → Auto Lock On When Attacking]. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]You can now switch your lock on target to off-screen enemies when fighting the Black Rabbit Brotherhood.[/h3][p][/p][h3]The attack timings and motions of the "Door Guardian" have been improved, and its weak spot is now more clearly visible.[/h3][p][/p][h3]Records that were mutually exclusive can now be acquired in a single playthrough.[/h3][p][/p][h3]Added new playlist and playback features to the gramophone.[/h3][list][*][p] You can now remove records from your playlist.[/p][/*][*][p] Three playback modes are now available: repeat the entire playlist, repeat a single record, or shuffle the playlist.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Added QoL features to access "Held Ergo".[/h3][list][*][p] In the "Level Up" menu, you can now use the Ergo held in your Bag via the new "Add Ergo" feature.[/p][/*][*][p] The "Add Ergo" feature has also been added to shops, the "Weapon Upgrade" menu, and the "Alter Handle" menu.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Improved the UI for Gold Coin Fruit and required Ergo[/h3][list][*][p] Added a gauge that shows how much Gold Coin Fruit can be picked from the Gold Coin Tree.[/p][/*][*][p] Added a gauge that shows how much more Ergo is needed to level up.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]QoL changes have been made to the "Level Up" system.[/h3][list][*][p] You can now use any Stargazers outside the hotel to level up.[/p][/*][*][p] Inside the hotel, you can level up by talking to Sophia.[/p][/*][*][p] In all playthroughs, you can level up using the Hotel Stargazer starting from Chapter 9.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Blue butterflies will now appear around Sophia during important moments when you need to talk to her.[/h3][p][/p][h3]Updated quest progress indicators.[/h3][list][*][p] A marker will now appear in the "Teleport to another Stargazer" menu when you can progress a quest.[/p][/*][*][p] The marker will also appear when using the Moonphase Pocket Watch.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Added new features to NPC dialogues.[/h3][list][*][p] You can now choose to "Auto-advance" dialogue when talking to NPCs. This option can be toggled on/off during dialogues.[/p][/*][*][p] NPC dialogues and subtitles will now continue even when you navigate to a menu.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]The notification prompting players to start a new playthrough has been updated to clearly present the available options: "Start Next Playthrough" or "Return to the Hotel".[/h3][p][/p][h3]Added and updated features in the "Weapon Assemble" and "Weapon Upgrade" menus.[/h3][list][*][p] A warning will appear when assembling a weapon that will execute certain types of attacks ineffectively.[/p][/*][*][p] Newly acquired weapons will be shown first in the "Upgrade Weapon", "Alter Handle", and "Assemble Weapons" menus.[/p][/*][*][p] New UI effects will appear when a weapon is fully upgraded.[/p][/*][*][p] New UI effects will appear when leveling up a Legion Arm modification.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Added a Weight preview feature to the "Equipment" menu.[/h3][list][*][p] Before equipping an item, you can check how your Weight will change by selecting the item.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]A warning will now appear when you attempt to use or sell Rare Ergo.[/h3][p][/p][h3]When selecting the upper/lower belt, pressing and holding the alternative key will now automatically select the item in the belt's first slot.[/h3][p][/p][h3]Additional key customization options now available in \[Settings → Keyboard & Mouse → Key Settings] and \[Settings → Keyboard & Mouse → Menu Key Settings].[/h3][p][/p][h3]Added a new setting that adjusts Lock On Switch Sensitivity.[/h3][list][*][p] \[Settings → Controller → Controller Lock On Switch Sensitivity][/p][/*][*][p] \[Settings → Keyboard & Mouse → Mouse Lock On Switch Sensitivity][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Added an optional setting that will rotate the camera to match the direction of the character's movement.[/h3][list][*][p] \[Settings → Camera → Controller → Camera Auto Rotation][/p][/*][*][p] \[Settings → Camera → Mouse → Camera Auto Rotation][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3](PC ONLY) Added an option to enable game audio when the game is not the active application.[/h3][list][*][p] \[Settings → Audio → Controller → Play Audio When Inactive][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]AMD FSR 3.1 is now supported in the Windows version of Lies of P.[/h3][list][*][p] AMD FSR 3.1 settings can be adjusted in \[Settings → Graphics → AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 3].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]The End User License Agreement (EULA) has been revised in all languages to address spelling and clarity issues. Players will be required to accept the revised EULA after installing this patch.[/h3][p][/p][h3]In addition to the major updates listed above, more changes are included in this patch, including translation improvements, graphical updates, and more.[/h3]

notes.title: Update Notes Version 1.5.0.0
notes.content:
Hello citizens of Krat,
This is the Lies of P Team.

The Feburary 13th update has been released. 

Please refer below for further details on the update. 

[b]New Features and Content[/b]
After installing the latest update, the following items can be found in the 'Equipment' and 'Bag' menus.
 - Azure Dragon Crescent Glaive
 - Armor of the Honorable
 - Bandana of the Honorable


[b]Improvements[/b]
- Improved the Japanese translation.
- Players can now reset P-Organ upon new game without paying Gold Coin Fruit. 


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed a bug where the attack speed increase effect of the 'Frozen Feast' would not apply under certain situations. 
- Fixed a bug in which using the 'Proof of Humanity' would cause intermittent malfunctions in switching weapons. 
-Fixed a bug in which using the 'Proof of Humanity' Special Attack would cause the attribute effects from Grinders to be ineffective.
-Fixed a bug where 'Nameless Puppet' would intermittently disappear.
-Fixed a bug where unintended changes would happen while using the 'Alter Handle' menu.
-Fixed a bug where a certain elevator and lever in 'Arche Abbey' would intermittently spawn in unintended areas.
-Fixed a bug where players could fall into an impassable area.
-Fixed bugs related to certain in-game UI.
-Fixed typos in certain dialogues.

notes.title: Update Notes Version 1.3.0.0
notes.content:
Hello citizens of Krat,
This is the Lies of P Team. 

We extend our heartfelt appreciation for the overwhelming support you have shown us since our last Director's Letter. 
For the detailed information on today's update, please refer to the Patch Notes below. 

As mentioned in the Director's Letter video, the Lies of P soundtrack will be officially released on Steam on November 14th 9PM (PST), with digital music streaming becoming accessible on November 15th 7PM (PST).
We sincerely hope you enjoy. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1938420/P__Lies_of_P_Soundtrack/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/36531/P__Lies_of_P_PREMIUM_EDITION/

Lastly, Lies of P has been nominated for the 'Best Art Direction' and 'Best RPG' for the The Game Awards 2023
We are honored and would like to thank everyone who has made this possible.
Cast your votes in the link below!

Best Art Direction
[url=https://thegameawards.com/nominees/best-art-direction]https://thegameawards.com/nominees/best-art-direction[/url]

Best RPG
[url=https://thegameawards.com/nominees/best-role-playing]https://thegameawards.com/nominees/best-role-playing[/url]

We want to express our gratitude once again to all the players who consistently show interest and support for Lies of P. 

Thank you. 

---------------------------------------------
[h2]New Features and Content	
[/h2]	
	New costumes have been added to the game.
	After installing the latest update, the following items can be found in the 'Equipment' and 'Bag' menu.
[list]
[*] 	'Alchemist’s Hat'
[*] 	'Treasure Hunter’s Mask'
[*] 	'Treasure Hunter’s Hunting Apparel'
[*] 	'Illusory Emerald Glasses'
[/list]
	
	Added a new category to the Costume menu.
[list]
[*] 	Now players can equip the 'Mask' and 'Accessory' together in the Hair section in the costume menu.
[/list]
	
	Short Grey Hair' has been added to the game.
[list]
[*] 	Available after reaching any of the game's ending for the first time.
[*] 	Available at 'Geppetto's Tools'.
[/list]
	
	Add a new option to adjust the Subtitle's size.
[list]
[*] 	Can be adjusted by [Settings -> Gameplay  -> Subtitle size]
[/list]
	
	
[h2]Balance and Content Improvements	
[/h2]	
	Decreased Field Difficulty
[list]
[*] 	Adjusted the attack speed of some monsters to make their attack more intuitive.
[*] 	Increased the duration of stance breaks for some monsters.
[*] 	Adjusted the spawn locations of some monsters and traps to fit better with the flow of the game.
[/list]
	
	The P-Organ, 'Rising Dodge' has been changed to a default ability
[list]
[*] 	Retain Guard Regain upon Pulse Cell use' has been added to the P-Organ system to replace 'Rising Dodge'.
[/list]
	
	Combat Balance Adjustments
[list]
[*] 	Increased the damage of some weapons.
[*] 	Increased some weapons to trigger stance breaks to monsters more frequently.
[*] 	Now relatively lighter Blades will gain more 'Guard Regain', while heavier Blades gain less 'Guard Regain'.
[*] 	Decreased the delay after an attack and the time to charge a 'Charge Attack' for some heavy handles.
[*] 	Now some heavier handles will have a faster attack speed depending on the assembled blade.
[*] 	Adjusted the 'Destruction Damage' inflicted to monsets by a 'Perfect Guard'.
[*] 	The weapon 'Puppet’s Saber Blade' will now have increased stats after enhancing.
[*] 	Increased the movement distance while using the 'Proof of Humanity' weapon's attack skill.
[*] 	Increased the damage reduction rate while guarding the weapon 'Etiquette' but reduced the fable’s charge amount for a set period of time when attacking.
[*] 	Enhanced the attack tracking mechanism after successfully performing the Fable Arts, 'Guard Parry'.
[*] 	Increased the damage buff of 'Bell of Provocation' to the player.
[*] 	"The Attribute Status Ailments will now stack faster for the following Fable Arts:
[*] - 'Thunderstrike'
[*] - 'Flamestrike'
[*] - 'Acid Slash'"
[*] 	Increased the damage of Fatal Attacks to better scale with the players stats.
[*] 	Increased the attack radius and tracking mechanism of the Legion Arm, 'Aegis III - Counter Charge'.
[*] 	The pillars in the 'Kill King’s Flame, Fuoco's room will now only be destroyed by Fuoco's Fury Attacks.
[/list]
	
	Added new itmes to the NPC 'Polendina's Shop.
[list]
[*] 	2 more Quartz can be purchased during the early stages of the game.
[*] 	After expanding the shop for the 1st time, 1 additional 'Quartz' can be purchased. (Yes, 1 more Quartz.)
[*] 	After expanding the shop for the 3rd time, 2 additional 'Full Moonstone of the Covenant' can be purchased.
[/list]
	
	
[h2]Bug Fixes	
[/h2]	
	Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the character to shoot into the sky while using the Legion Arm 'Puppet String III - Attack Link'.
	Fixed a bug while continuously pressing the guard button during the Guard stance Legion Arm 'Aegis' would trigger Perfect Guards every time.
	Fixed a bug that allowed some weapons to perform Perfect Guards unintentionally.
	Fixed a bug that caused some Electric Blitz attacks to be unguardable even with Perfect Guards or Guard Parry.
	Fixed a bug in which the Guard Regain would not reset after performing a successful counter-attack with the weapon 'Two Dragons Sword's charge attack.
	Fixed a bug in which arrows fired from traps could not be guarded.
	Fixed a bug in which the 'Monnphase Pocket Watch' could be used during boss fights.
	Fixed a bug in which attacks from some monsters would not register correctly to the player character.
	Fixed a bug in which the P-Organ ability 'Naturally recovers Durability of inactive weapons' reduced the weapon's durability while inactive during certain situations.
	Fixed a bug in which having the P-Organ 'Lower Damage while Dodging' activated and a specific Amulet equipped would trigger the player's stamina regain earlier than intended.
	Fixed a bug in which the deceased NPC 'Belle' at the 'Attacked Hotel Krat'.
	Fixed a bug in which players were able to abnormally approach certain areas of the map.
	Adjusted the Camera Rotation speed while using controllers to be not affected by the framerate.
	(Specific for Asian Regions) PS4 Controller Settings Resetting Issue has now been fixed and can be save regardless of the PS4's system settings.
	Updated some translations and typos for the following languages:
- 'English'
- 'Chinese'
- 'Japanese'
	Updated a typo in the in-game EULA.
	Improved game stability and bugs related to in-game UI.

notes.title: Lies of P gets November patch, DLC, and sequel plans
notes.content:
A patch is coming to Lies of P along with DLC, and a sequel is also planned.

This is according to the game's director Ji Won Choi, who teased as much in a director's video that outlined balance tweaks coming with a November patch.

Some of the changes coming with the patch include easier difficulty during the earlier stages of the game by making the Rising Dodge ability available by default.

Read more

notes.title: Update Notes Version 1.2.0.0
notes.content:
[h3][b]Balance Changes        [/b][/h3]
[b]Field Monster Balance Changes[/b]
- Decreased the HP of certain field monsters
- Increased the chance of breaking some monsters' stance and the frequency of stagger
- Increased the staggerable window time
        
[b]Decrease the HP of all 3 types of Dimensional Butterflies[/b]
        
[h3][b]Adjusted the rewards for some monsters[/b][/h3]
- Increased the drop rate of Moonstone type items
- Decreased the drop rate of Star Fragments
- Increased the drop rate of Ergo items
- Increased the Ergo rewards of certain monsters that appear after Lorenzini Arcade"
        
[h3][b]Boss Monster Balance Changes[/b][/h3]
- Decreased the HP of 'Fallen Archbishop Andreus'
- Decreased the HP of 'King of Puppets' in the first phase
- Decreased the HP of 'Simon Manus, Arm of God'
- Decreased the damage of 'Simon Manus, Awakened God'
- Increased the chance to break the stance of 'Simon Manus, Awakened God'"
        
[b]Increased the Specter's HP and damage[/b]
        
[h3][b]System Changes Related to the Character Progression Reset[/b][/h3]
- Added the feature to reset the character's level, P-Organ, and Legion Arms at the 'Gold Coin Tree'
- Characters created after this patch will now receive 8 Gold Coin Fruits instead of 5 for their first harvest
- Adjusted the required amount of gold coins to reset the character's level, P-Organ, and Legion Arms
        
[h3][b]Additional Changes[/b][/h3]
- Players will now be able to carry more weight for each point spent on Capacity
- Decreased the weight of Amulets that could be purchased with Boss Ergo
- Players will now be able to land attacks better when they use fable arts that consume three or more slots. (includes Fable Arts that stack)
- Successfully performing the Fable Art 'Guard Parry' will now break the monster's stance
        
        
[h3][b]New Features     [/b][/h3]   
Now supports the DUALSHOCK®4 & DualSense™ controllers on Windows OS devices

After today's update, if the DUALSHOCK®4 & DualSense™ UI does not appear properly please follow the steps below.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40566812/a502ea42ceaa40d44491781c5d06885e01394283.png[/img]
1. Steam Library -> Right Click Lies of P -> Properties -> Controller
2. Disable Steam Input
** The DUALSHOCK®4 & DualSense™ controller's touch pad can be used to open the menu
        
[h3][b]Bug Fixes  [/b][/h3]      
- Fixed a bug with the Legion Arm 'Pandemonium II - Acid Charge' rarely not working properly.
- Fixed a bug that the Legion Arm 'Pandemonium' consumed only Legion guage while using Grindstones
- Fixed a bug that Geppetto's face to flicker in the cutscene after defeating the 'Nameless Puppet'  with Graphic Quality Presets - Low
- Fixed a typo of Carlo Collodi in the End Credits. (We sincerely apologize to Mr. Collodi and that was not a lie!)


[h2][b]Known Issues[/b][/h2]
[b][PS4 Controller Settings Resetting Issue][/b]
Changes made to controller settings cannot be saved when the [Use X button for Enter] option is disabled. This feature is exclusive to PS4 systems in Asian regions. If you are facing constant resetting of your PS4 controller settings, please follow the instructions below to enable the [Use X button for Enter]  option.
PS4 User Guide: https://manuals.playstation.net/document/en/ps4/settings/crossbutton.html
To change the key binding for 'Confirm' from the O button to the X button, navigate to [Settings] → [System], and check the [Use X button for Enter] checkbox.

[b][Inability to Proceed to Chapter 3][/b]
Some players have encountered difficulties in advancing to subsequent chapters due to abnormal actions, such as passing through doors in unconventional ways. To resolve this issue, please follow the instructions below:

Install the latest patch.
Launch the game and activate any Stargazer ability.
Visit the Hotel and interact with Geppetto to trigger a P-Organ cutscene.
Acquire the Krat City Hall Key.

[b][DUALSHOCK®4 & DualSense™ Controller Display Error on Windows][/b]
If you trigger keyboard input while using the DUALSHOCK®4 & DualSense™ controller on a Windows operating system, the game's input UI may switch to that of a keyboard. In this case, the key binding for 'Menu' will be displayed as 'C', instead of 'ESC'.

notes.title: Lies of P Demo Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, it’s the Lies of P team!

We would like to share our deepest gratitude to all of our fans who have supported us and endured patiently. It is our delight to announce the Demo of Lies of P!

We hope the Demo would be an enjoyable experience for all who have waited for so long.

Along with our Demo announcement, also check out our brand-new trailer.
[previewyoutube=OmJOKuTWmS4;full][/previewyoutube]

For more details on the Lies of P Demo, we have prepared some key notes below.

[h3]Available dates for the Demo[/h3]
The Demo version of Lies of P will be playable only for a limited time from June 8 ~ 26.
So do not hesitate or you might lose the opportunity!

[h3]Contents of the Demo [/h3]
The Demo version of Lies of P will feature the first two chapters of the full game.
Any progress made in the Demo version will not carry over to the full-release version.

[h3]Demo Survey[/h3]
Please leave your comments and opinions regarding the Demo version.
Your voices will be vital as we continue our preparations for the full release!!
[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScWysya6GSuwiDaWbRbwSlbA5vR2TO2Er4KHaSjjpEO46D24Q/viewform](Survey Link)[/url]

[h3]AMD Graphic Drivers[/h3]
For a more butterfly smooth playing experience, we recommend players with Radeon graphics cards update to the latest versions (June 1st version recommended at least).

[h3]Crash Reports[/h3]
If for any reason the game crashes a Crash Report folder will be created under the following directory "LiesofP\Saved\Crashes”.
If you encounter any game crashes please share the entire contents of this folder to the following email address lop_support@neowiz.com. 
They will be thoroughly inspected and fixed before the full release.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40566812/8d6a127e693d57172b9a445199c212663b8facd6.png[/img]

[h3]Other Important Notes[/h3]
The Demo version is still a work-in-progress version which does not represent the full-release product.
The Demo version may include some awkward translations.
To play the Demo version, an online connection is required.


Your adventure begins now, take the first steps into Krat which has fallen into darkness and madness.
Once again we would like to thank all of our fans who have eagerly waited for Lies of P.
We hope our hard work will be enough to match the love and support we have received.

Thank you.
